source: Existing DAI milestone template, unchanged in this extraction

milestones.title: Blood work: HIV, syphilis & anaemia screening
milestones.guidance: Complete the pending blood work at the nearest lab — this screens for infections and anaemia that raise risk later in pregnancy.

milestones.title: Dating ultrasound
milestones.guidance: Book a dating ultrasound to confirm gestational age and rule out early complications.

milestones.title: Second antenatal visit
milestones.guidance: Schedule the second antenatal visit — spacing between visits is how early warning signs get caught.

milestones.title: Glucose tolerance test
milestones.guidance: Take the glucose tolerance test to screen for gestational diabetes before the third trimester.

milestones.title: Haemoglobin recheck & Anti-D
milestones.guidance: Book a haemoglobin recheck. Anaemia is treatable now but raises delivery risk if it's still low at week 36.

milestones.title: Birth plan & facility readiness
milestones.guidance: Confirm the birth plan and facility readiness with your doctor before week 38.

milestones.title: Six-week postnatal visit
milestones.guidance: Attend the six-week postnatal visit — this is when postpartum recovery and mental health are screened.

milestones.title: BCG, OPV-0 & Hepatitis-B birth dose
milestones.guidance: Visit the nearest PHC for the birth-dose vaccines (BCG, OPV-0, Hepatitis-B) — ideally within the first week.

milestones.title: Penta-1, OPV-1 & Rotavirus-1
milestones.guidance: Book Penta-1, OPV-1 & Rotavirus-1 — protects against six serious childhood diseases.
